author: DAN KOE
text: Focus is becoming the rarest skill on the planet. Talent, intelligence, marketing, prompting, vibe coding, and whatever else doesn't matter as much as being able to channel your attention for an extended period of time into one useful thing that you want to see in the world.

topReplies.author: Seb Kersten
topReplies.text:
Here are my Top 5 battle-tested frameworks to protect focus:

1. The Pomodoro Technique: Intense 25-minute sprints followed by a 5-minute recovery. It's interval training for your attention.

2.  Deep Work Blocks: Schedule 90-120 minute blocks of zero-distraction time in your calendar. This is where real progress happens.

3.  The Eisenhower Matrix: A simple grid to separate the Urgent from the Important. It forces you to focus on what truly moves the needle.
